correction: The initial environment profile guarded furnace_on==0 without a demonstrated editor branch. The investigation initially looked for a furnace checkbox, but the retained editor300 slot map has no such control, and the environment fill/apply/constant-copy bodies neither branch on nor write SC+3c0. That guard excludes otherwise recovered behavior and should be removed; do not invent a furnace checkbox or Save-time furnace snapshot.
original_environment_contract: SC+3c0 is a byte furnace enable flag; the separate owned furnace starts at SC+440. Environment fill 0x140ec3fa0 operates on ENVTMP and its constant/table controls, CNVCOF/ENVATM/ACVCOF, pressure/scalars, VFACTR and TIMEID. No furnace-flag test is present.

The constant ENVTMP callback 0x140eccb50 updates radio selections and enable states only. Constant Apply 0x140ec9b30 copies the four remembered environment curves; environment Apply 0x140ec50f0 then processes seven scalars and VFACTR. Neither assigns the furnace flag, name, curve list or furnace flags.

Consequently ordinary environment conversion can round ENVTMP g6 text while leaving the current furnace flag and owned furnace state untouched. A later change to that live furnace state must not be reverted from an invented editor snapshot.
constructor_copy_contract: Existing final refresh 0x140ecb340 creates an initialized SC backup, deep-copies current SC into it, refills pages, then invokes the same field-aware copy back.

GUI dispatcher 0x1408df7b0 calls seven helpers; the environment helper is 0x1408d6a50. Its aligned instructions copy +3a8/+3b8, ENVTMP+3c8, furnace+440, CNVCOF+4c0, ENVATM+538, ACVCOF+5b0, TIMEID and later curves, then remaining scalars. It omits +3c0, matching existing native sim_copy_environment.

GUI furnace-copy 0x1409f0230 reads source list count, clears/setup destination list, copies each curve through the recovered DYNARY copier, and strcpy-copies the name. Existing native furnace_copy has the same field-aware sequence. It does not copy the +58..6f byte flags wholesale.

The active flag does not activate a new branch in this copy sequence. Preserve its original omission rather than repairing the copy into whole-object assignment. The existing initialized-backup contract still applies.
planned_changes: Remove only furnace_on!=0 from fillEnvironment3D refusal and update the public helper comment that currently says furnace off.
Do not add new furnace state to EnvironmentPage or modify native model copy functions, Session/Ctx/core, original evidence, public editor300 guard or unrelated environment restrictions.

exact_tests.name: environment_active_furnace_flag_and_live_owned_state_are_not_editor_snapshot_fields
exact_tests.setup: For active byte values 1,2,255, initialize a normal 3D model and distinct ENVTMP value, furnace name, first curve value and furnace byte flags. Fill succeeds. Mutate the live furnace flag/name/curve/byte flags after fill.
exact_tests.acceptance: Apply performs existing ENVTMP rounding, but retains every later live furnace value without normalization or snapshot restoration.

exact_tests.name: initial_editor_active_furnace_survives_backup_refresh_and_apply_retains_later_live_state
exact_tests.setup: Initialize the existing supported full editor profile with active furnace, a normal constructed curve list, distinct name/first curve value/metadata, and nondefault byte flags. Open through actual composer.
exact_tests.acceptance: Open succeeds, preserving original flag and furnace content through backup/refill. Mutate the live furnace after Open; composed Apply retains those later changes while applying remembered ordinary environment controls.

exact_tests.name: environment_unrecovered_profiles_refuse_before_mutating_input
exact_tests.setup: Amend the existing furnace-only refusal assertion into active-furnace plus still-unsupported TIMEID or variable-curve cases.
exact_tests.acceptance: Other unknown branches still refuse without changing active furnace state; no broad profile relaxation.

qualification: This is a correction of one evidence-disproved helper guard, not a claim that every active-furnace public lifecycle or loader/serializer branch is recovered. The public editor300 dispatch remains guarded.
Retained static code and the existing valid constructed/loaded model profile are the oracle for this increment; malformed furnace strings/lists and arbitrary memory corruption are not newly accepted.
The field-aware copy is not a whole-struct copy: untouched fields and original omissions remain intact. No original runtime or app-control session was used.
